user.title: STIGA.GO account
user.description:
Sign in with the account you use in the STIGA.GO app.

This integration is built on Matthew Gream's [stiga-api]({stiga_api_url}), which also offers a web interface, analysis tools and command-line tools for STIGA robots.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate STIGA
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} was rejected. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the STIGA cloud.
error.no_robots: No robot mowers found on this account.
error.unknown_broker: Your robot is on a STIGA server whose certificate this integration cannot verify yet. Please open an issue on the integration's GitHub page.

create_entry.default:
Your robot mowers have been added.

The protocol support comes from Matthew Gream's [stiga-api]({stiga_api_url}); see it for more STIGA tools.

init.title: Schedule blocks
init.description: Parts of the day that get a switch per weekday (on half hours). Leave a name empty to remove that block. An end of 00:00 means midnight. Mowing times outside these blocks are left untouched.

error.half_hour: Times must be on a full or half hour.
error.missing_time: Every named block needs a start and an end.
error.end_before_start: A block must end after it starts.

unknown_broker.message: STIGA MQTT broker {broker} has no pinned certificate authority, so its certificate cannot be verified and the integration will not connect. Please open an issue at {issue_url}.
